main.description: Issues a single-use, two-minute ticket for the caller to grant the operator authority over a workspace account's workspaces (the caller's own account, or the one named by authority), and returns the operator URL that starts the flow. The caller opens it as a top-level navigation; the flow succeeds only for someone who signs in as that account. For createWorkspace with another account, it also leaves the caller an approval to create that one workspace.

name.description: The workspace to create, for purpose createWorkspace.

authority.description: The workspace account to approve for. Omitted, the caller's own.
